text_block_list.text:
In her interview, Ines Fujin boldly 
declares, "I will win the Japanese Derby 
as the number one favorite!"

A dream pursued hand-in-hand with Trainer. 
Born of deep mutual trust, there was no 
hesitation in her eyes.

Meanwhile, Mejiro Ryan, who made it this 
far inspired by Ines Fujin, told her, 
"Through you, I saw my own dream."

However, Ines Fujin has a dream she 
refuses to yield. After all, her younger 
sisters have come to cheer for her at this 
very "Japanese Derby"!
